facilityTypes.title: A. Self-Evaluation Tool for Daycare Facilities (Creches)

sections.title: 1. Care and Support before birth/ Kwita ku mwana mbere y’uko avuka

items.text: Pregnant mothers are visited at home to ensure they attend antenatal services (Evidence of home visitation)/ Gusura ababyeyi batwite mu ngo birakorwa.
The facility files the reports of home visit/ Irerero rikora raporo zo gusura ababyeyi batwite rikazibika.

The daycare checks if pregnant mothers respect the protocols for antenatal visits as prescribed./ Irerero rigenzura ko ababyeyi batwite bakurikiza gahunda yo kwisuzumisha mbere yo kubyara nk’uko iteganyijwe.
The day-care facility encourages fathers to ensure the security of their pregnant woman/ Irerero rikangurira ababyeyi b’abagabo kwita ku mutekano w’abagore babo batwite.

sections.title: 2. Food and Nutrition practices

items.text: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per MIYCN counselling package/ Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye.

ECD food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety/ Abatetsi n’abandi bafite aho bahurira n’amafunguro bahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye n’umutekano n’isuku y’ibiribwa.
Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and covering their hair./ Abatetsi bapfuka imisatsi yabo bambara ingofero kandi bakagira umwambaro ubaranga
Children with eating difficulties are identified and receive adequate support/ Abana bagaragaje ibibazo mu mirire bafashwa bahabwa indyo ikungahaye ku ntungamubiri zikwiye.
Clean drinking water is always available to children/ Abana bahabwa amazi yo kunywa ku buryo buhoraho
Children attending all day are offered meals at designated intervals/ Abana bamara umunsi wose mu irerero bagaburirwa mu byiciro bidahindagurika

Staff request information from parents about any special dietary requirements, preferences or food allergies the child may have/ Abarezi babaza ababyeyi amakuru ku bijyanye n’ibiribwa abana bakunda, n’ibibagiraho ingaruka.
Facilities for the hygienic preparation of babies’ foods are available./ Irerero rigira ibikoresho by’isuku bijyanye no gutegura amafunguro
Suitable sterilization equipment is used for babies’ feeding equipment before every meal./ Ibikoresho byica za ikorobe bikoreshwa mu gutunganya ibikoresho byo ku meza.

ECD caregivers are trained how to adapt feeding practices to minimize harm and maximize nutritional intake for children with eating and drinking difficulties/ Abarezi bahugurwa ku byahinduka mu migaburirire kugira ngo bagabanye ingaruka z’imirire mibi

ECD caregivers ensure that children aged 6–23 months receive micronutrient powders/ Abarezi mu irerero bagenzura ko abana bafite amezi kuva kuri 6 kugeza kuri 23 bahabwa ifu ya Ongera Intungamubiri cyangwa ibindi biribwa byunganira mu mirire.

Parents/caregivers receive monthly cooking demonstrations and sessions on holistic child development at the facilities./ Ababyeyi bombi bahabwa amasomo yo guteka n’amasomo ku mikurire y’umwana mu buryo bukomatanyije ku irerero.
ECD caregivers encourage parents to provide adequate complementary food in addition to breast milk after 6 months./ Abarezi bashishikariza ababyeyi guha abana imfashabere nyuma y’amezi 6

sections.title: 4. Responsive care and support services to children from birth to 3 years/ Kwita ku bana bavutse kugeza ku myaka 3

items.text: The daycare has records of whether the working parents took maternity and paternity leave./ Abatanga ikiruhuko cy’ababyeyi bagomba kugenzura ko umubyeyi ahabwa igihe gihagije k’ikiruhuko.

Support and guidance are provided for parents and families of children having developmental delay or disability./ Ababyeyi cyangwa imiryango ifite abana bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha.
Both parents attend parenting sessions at the day-care facility./ Ababyeyi n’abandi barera abana bagomba gukurikirana amasomo ku burere mu miryango

The facility follows-up on whether CHWs and IZU conduct home visits to families with young children to monitor children’s growth./ Abajyanama b’ubuzima, Inshuti z’Umuryango basura imiryango ifite abana bato kugira ngo bakurikirane imikurire yabo.

sections.title: 5. Day-care staffing/ Abakozi b’Irerero

items.text: Caregivers have basic training in holistic child development, childcare methods and first aid./ Umurezi yahuguwe ku mikurire y’umwana mu buryo bukomatanyije, uburyo butandukanye bwo kwita ku bana bato no gutanga ubutabazi bw’ibanze.
Staff have medical certificates/ Buri mukozi mu irerero (daycare) afite ikemezo kigaragaza ko ari muzima gitanzwe n’umuganga ubifitiye ububasha mbere yo gutangira akazi.
Every staff member in a day care facility has a working contract./ Buri mukozi mu irerero afite amasezerano y’akazi yanditse.
There is a plan for continuous professional development of staff as required./ Hashyizweho gahunda y’amahugurwa ahoraho y’abakozi hagendewe ku byo umukozi akeneye guhugurwamo.

sections.title: 6. Physical Environment/ Imiterere y’Irerero

items.text: The day-care facility has access to the road./ Irerero rifite umuhanda urigeraho.

The day-care facility has an early learning room, breastfeeding room, sleeping room, kitchen, store, child-friendly toilets, outdoor playground./ Irerero rifite icyumba cyo kwigiramo, icyumba cyo konkerezamo, icyumba cyo kuryamamo cyangwa kuruhukiramo, igikoni, ububiko, imisarani iri ku kigero cy’abana, ahantu ho gukinira hanze.
The day-care facilities are not placed in a risky zone (landslides, erosion area, floods, etc.)/ Irerero ntiriri ahantu h’amanegeka hashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza (inkangu, isuri, imyuzure, n’ibindi
There is a good lighting system./ Ibyumba bifite urumuri ruhagije;
Play areas are large enough to allow free movement (2mX2m/Child=4 sqm) - Total square of playground/Total number of children./ Aho abana bakinira harahagije ku buryo buri mwana yisanzura.

sections.title: 7. Sanitary Facilities/ Ibikoresho by’Isuku mu Irerero

items.text: There is a clean, washable, hygienic space to change diapers; and a safe disposal of child faeces/ Hari ahantu hasukuye, hozwa, kandi hafite isuku, bahindurira abana ibyo bababinze igihe babyitumyemo kandi hakaba ahantu bajugunya imyanda y’abana hafite umutekano.
The toilets are appropriate for children with separate toilets for boys and girls./ Irerero rifite imisarane iri ku kigero cy’abana imisarane n’abahungu itandukanye n’iy’abakobwa.
Every child has a labelled potty / Buri mwana afite agatebe ke ko kwitumamo kanditseho amazina ye.
Potties are cleaned and sanitized after each use./ Agatebe k’umwana yitumyemo karasukurwa kandi kakarindwa mikorobe nyuma y’uko umwana agakoresheje.
Every child has at least one pair of bed sheets./ Buri mwana afite nibura amashuka abiri.
Sanitary materials are kept out of children’s reach./ Ibikoresho byose by’isuku bibikwa kure aho abana batagera kugira ngo bitaba byabakomeretsa.
Waste bins are covered./ Aho bamena imyanda harapfundikirwa
Children are guided on how to use waste bins./ Abana berekwa uko bakoresha ububiko bw’imyanda.
There is at least one toilet specifically designed for children with special needs and one for staff with special needs./ Irerero rifite umusarani w’abafite ubumuga ku bana no ku barezi.

sections.title: 8. Handwashing practices/ Gukaraba Intoki

items.text: There is a poster reminding people to wash their hands./ Hari icyapa kigisha abana uburyo bwo gukaraba intoki.
Staff ensure that children wash their hands before eating and after using the toilet./ Abarezi n’abana bagenzura ko bakoresha igihe cyagenwe mu gukaraba intoki: hagati y’amasogonda 40-60
Staff have written guidelines on when to wash hands./ Aho bakarabira mu ntoki haba hari amazi meza n’isabune.

sections.title: 9. Building specifications/ Ibisabwa ku Nyubako

items.text:
The facility has protection for children in windows and anywhere children may fall (all conditions have to be met)/ Igihe irerero rikoreye mu nzu yo hejuru, inyubako igomba kugira senyenge mu madirishya no ku ibaraza.
Note: If there is anywhere in the compound where children may fall and it is not protected, the whole standard is not met.

The location of the facility is away from hazards (public toilets, rubbish dumps, main roads, etc.)/ Irerero riri kure y’imisarani ya rusange, ibimoteri, umuhanda munini cyangwa ikindi kintu cyateza impanuka ku barikoreramo.
The doors are fixed, and none is swinging./ Nta nzugi zifunga zikifungura zikoreshwa ku miryango yo mu irerero.
The floor has a smooth, non-slip surface./ Mu cyumba k’ishuri hasi aho abana bakorera ibikorwa bitandukanye nta byobo bihari ahubwo hahora hashashe, hozwa kandi hatanyerera.

The facility has an area for recreational activities./ Irerero rifite ahantu hagenewe ibikorwa by’imikino no kuruhuka.
Note: this can be indoor or outdoor
The facility has storage areas for children’s things./ Buri mwana mu irerero afite ububiko bw’ibintu bye.
The drains are covered./ Imiyoboro y’amazi iratwikiriye.

Staircases are closed at both ends./ Ahari ingazi hose zirafunze ku mpera zombi.
Note: this applies to storeyed building

Electric sockets are raised to be out of reach of children and rendered harmless./ Aho bacomekera ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi higiye hejuru aho abana batagera kandi hararindwa ku buryo hatateza abana impanuka.
The day-care facility is inclusive. (The facility can accommodate children with disabilities)/ Irerero ryakira abana bose ridaheza abafite ubumuga.
The facility is equipped with learning materials accessible to all children./ Irerero rifite imfashanyigisho n’ibikinisho bifasha abana mu myigire kandi zidaheza abana bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 10. Equipment/Ibikoresho

items.text: Furniture (chairs and tables) is appropriate for children’s size and age. (30 cm high)/ Intebe n’ameza bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana.
Equipment is arranged to create an accessible and stimulating environment/ Ibikoresho biteguye mu buryo bushimishije, butabuza abana kwisanzura no gukora ingendo.

The equipment is of suitable design and condition, well maintained and conforms to safety standards./ Ibikoresho bikoze mu mashusho atandukanye atuma bishimisha abana, byitabwaho kandi ntibibangamiye umutekano w’abana.
The play equipment is stimulating and safe for children./ Ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho bikurura abana kandi bishobora gukoreshwa mu bikorwa bitandukanye by’imikino.
There are sufficient and suitable indoor and outdoor toys and play materials. (Every child can have a toy/play material without watching others playing) / Hari ibikinisho bihagije kandi bikwiye

There are sufficient, safe and age appropriate chairs, tables, carpets and mats to allow children to play and eat together./ Hari umubare uhagije w’intebe n’ameza bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana ndetse n’imikeka kugira ngo abana bashobore gukina no gusangirira amafunguro hamwe.

sections.title: 11. Breastfeeding Room/ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo

items.text: The room is easy to reach directly, away from the bathroom, away from where garbage and other old materials are disposed of./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo kiri ahantu horoshye kugera, kure y’ubwiherero, kure y’aho bamena imyanda n’ibindi bintu.

It complies with privacy standards, with the door securely locked and equipment to screen lactating mothers if they wish./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo gifite urugi rukingwa ku buryo umubyeyi aba yihereye.
It provides fresh air or a ventilation system./ Icyumba gifite icyuma gitanga umuyaga kugira ngo ababyeyi baruhuke neza igihe bonsa

There are handwashing facilities, soap, clean hand towels or paper towels./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo gifite ibikoresho bifasha mu gukaraba intoki: isabune, isume isukuye cyangwa impapuro z’isuku zabugenewe.
There is safe water for drinking and washing hands./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo gifite amazi meza yo kunywa n’ayo gukaraba intoki.

The room has a chair and a table adapted for the lactating mother, and other necessary equipment when the mother is breastfeeding./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo gifite intebe n’ameza bikwiriye umubyeyi uri konsa, n’ibindi bikoresho yakenera.
The room has a small baby bed (cot/berceau). / Icyumba gifite uburiri bw’umwana.
If used by more than one mother, the seats are separated by a curtain to ensure privacy/ Mu gihe icyumba cyo konkerezamo gikoreshwa n’ababyeyi barenze umwe, intebe zabo itanduknywa n’amarido.
The breastfeeding room has a sink to clean the cups used by the mother when extracting milk./ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo gifite aho kogereza udukombe dukoreshwa igihe umubyeyi yikama amashyereka.
The room has facilities for extraction of breast milk/ Icyumba gifite ibikoresho bifasha umubyeyi igihe yikama amashyereka

Expressed breast milk (kept in a safe container at room temperature) is stored for no longer than 6–8 hours./ Amashyereka yakamwe abikwa mu gikoresho gifite umutekano ku bushyuhe buringaniye amara amasha hagati ya 6 na 8.

sections.title: 12. Care, learning and play/ Kwitabwaho, Kwiga no Gukina

items.text: Children are provided with items to look at, touch, smell, hear and taste./ Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bihagije bikangura ubwonko bwabo bahabwa ibintu byo kwitegereza, gukorakora, kwihumuriza, kumvisha amatwi no kumva uburyohe.
Children are given language stimulation activities: narrating stories, reading picture books, picture story books, singing, etc./ Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bihagije bizamura ubushobozi bwabo bw’ururimi.
Children are supported to acquire new motor, and thinking skills./ Abana bafashwa kuzamura ubushobozi mu miyego, no gutekereza.
Children are helped to learn how to control their own behavior/ Abana bafashwa kumenya uko bakwigenzurira imyitwarire yabo.

The daily schedule gives children opportunities to practise sensory activities with non-harmful materials/ Ibikorwa, ibikinisho, n’ibikoresho byo mu mikino biha abana umwanya wo gukoresha ibyumviro byabo n’ubunararibonye bafite mu buzima.
Caregivers plan to interact with every child every day on what they are doing./ Abarezi batega amatwi abana bakanabaganiza ku byo barigukora.

Children are given the opportunity to begin to care for themselves: dressing, feeding, washing, etc./ Abana bahabwa umwanya wo kwiga kwiyitaho: kwiyambika imyambaro, kwigaburira; kwikarabya intoki, n’ibindi
Sleeping is included in the daily schedule./ Abana bagira umwanya wo kuruhuka nk’uko biteganyijwe.
Children are washed before sleeping, and before and after mealtimes/ Abana buhagirwa mbere y’uko basinzira kugira ngo bagire ubuzima bwiza
There is adequate recreational space for children to relax./ Irerero riteganya ahantu heza abana bagomba gukinira baruhuka.
Play items are made of wood or non-toxic materials./ Irerero riha abana ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho zikozwe mu biti cyangwa bidasizeho irangi ryakwangiza.

Children with developmental delay or disability receive additional support to meet their individual learning needs/ Abana bagaragaye ko bafite ibibazo by’ubukererwe mu mikurire, abafite ibibazo byihariye cyangwa ubumuga, bahabwa ubufasha bw’inyongera.

There are swings, climbing frames and other playground equipment for gross motor skills development./ Irerero rigira ibikoresho by’imikino bitandukanye nk’imyicungo, ingazi zo kuzamukaho n’ibindi bikinisho.

sections.title: 13. Health/ Ubuzima

items.text: Children aged 0–2 are screened for risk of developmental delay or disability every 6 months. (present the report)/ Abana kugeza ku myaka 2 bakorerwa isuzuma buri mezi 6 rigamije kureba niba nta byago byo kudindira bafite cyangwa ubumuga.

Parents and caregivers ensure that their children have been immunized according to the vaccination schedule./ Ababyeyi n’abarezibagenzura ko abana bahabwa inkingo uko ziteganyijwe kuri gahunda y’ikingira.
Staff are taken through health screening before employment/ Mbere yo gutangira akazi, abakozi b’irerero bakorerwa isumwa ry’ubuzima bwabo muri rusange.

Staff are regularly made aware of the importance of good hygiene practices to prevent the spread of infection./ Abakozi bamenyeshwa kandi bagakangurirwa ibyiza by’isuku kugira ngo hirindwe ikwirakwizwa ry’indwara zandura.

ECD caregivers ensure that their children receive vitamin A and deworming as per Ministry of Health calendar./ Abarezi bagenzura ko abana bahabwa vitamin A, imiti y’inzoka hagendewe ku ngengabihe ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima.
Children are regularly monitored for healthy growth by the local CHW or health professionals./ Imikurire y’abana ikurikiranwa n’umujyanama w’ubuzima, cyangwa undi mukozi ushinzwe ubuzima.

There are protocols on handling sick children with infectious diseases and use of medicines. (showing the protocols/ guidelines)/ Hagomba kubaho amabwiriza y’uburyo bafata abana bafite indwara zandura n’imikoreshereze y’imiti mu irerero.
Medicines are clearly labelled and stored in their original containers./ Imiti igomba kubikwa mu bubiko bwayo kandi hagashyirwaho ikimenyetso.
Medicines are kept out of children’s reach./ Imiti igomba kubikwa kure aho abana batagera.
There are first aid kits and staff are trained on their use./ Irerero rifite nibura agasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze kandi abakozi bahuguriwe kugakoresha.

Specific attention is given to children with HIV/AIDS, special needs and disabilities to promote an inclusive, stigma-free environment and support nutrition and medication./ Abana bafite ubwandu bw’agakoko gatera Sida, abafite ibibazo byihariye n’abafite ubumuga bitabwaho by’umwihariko.

Owners of the day-care facility provide support to services for children with developmental delays and disabilities./ Nyiri irerero atanga ubufasha ku bana bafite ibibazo by’idindira mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.
The facilities ensure children have medical insurance./ Amarerero agenzura ko abana bafite ubwishingizi bw’indwara
The facilities conduct parent education sessions on family planning./ Amarerero ashyiraho gahunda y’amasomo ahabwa ababyeyi ku bijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro.
The facility has a health worker’s contact for health-related issues./ Irerero rifite inomero za terefone z’umujyanama w’ubuzima cyangwa abandi bakozi bashinzwe ubuzima.

sections.title: 14. Child safety and protection/ Umutekano no kurinda umwana ihohoterwa.

items.text: Caregivers are trained on safeguarding children’s rights and welfare./ Abakozi bahuguwe ku bibazo byose bijyanye no kurinda umwana ihohoterwa.
All staff are aware of the possible signs and symptoms of children at risk./ Abakozi bose basobanukiwe n’ibimenyetso biranga umwana wahohotewe.
There is a code of conduct on safeguarding child’s rights and child protection./ Hari amategeko ngengamyitwarire ku bijyanye n’uburenganzira bw’umwana no kumurinda ihohoterwa.
The facility is a drug-free environment. (having a sign post at the gate preventing any drug to enter the facility)/ Mu irerero ry’abana ntihinjiramo ibiyobyabwenge.

Parental consent is obtained before taking pictures of children or sharing information on social media. (Having it in the safeguarding child’s rights)/ Gufata amafoto y’abana no kuyasangiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bigomba uruhushya rutangwa n’ababyeyi.
There are mechanisms for dropping off and collecting children from the facility. (written instructions)/ Irerero rishyiraho ingamba zijyanye no kuhageza abana no kubacyura.
Drop-off and pick-up of children is supervised by a caregiver (schedule of who is on duty which day)/ Ibikorwa byose byo kugeza abana ku irerero no kubacyura bigenzurwa n’umurezi
The compound is fenced, with a guard and a lockable gate./ Irerero rigira uruzitiro, amarembo afungwa n’umuzamu kugira ngo umutekano w’abana ubungabungwe neza.

Electrical outlets accessible to a child have child-proof covers or safety outlets./ Aho bacomekera ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi haba hapfutse mu rwego rwo kurinda abana kugira ibyo binjizamo byabateza impanuka.
The premises are free from poisonous or potentially harmful plants./ Mu irerero imbere nta byatsi bihumanya birimo.
There are operational procedures for the safe conduct of any outings/ Irerero rigira amabwiriza ajyanye n’uko abantu bitwara barimo imbere n’iyo basohotse hanze

Records of vehicles in which children are transported, including insurance details, valid technical check-up and a list of named drivers are kept./ Irerero ribitse amakuru ajyanye n’imodoka zitwara abana: ubwishingizi bwazo, icyemezo cy’ubuziranenge bw’ikinyabiziga, amazina y’abashoferi na terefone zabo.
Sleeping babies are frequently supervised / Abana baragenzurwa igihe baryamye basinziriye.
The facility has fire extinguishers, sand or water and caregivers are trained on how to use them./ Irerero rifite ibikoresho byo kuzimya inkongi y’umuriro.
Toys, play materials and equipment are clean and safe for use by children./ Ibikinisho n’ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa mu mikino bigirirwa isuku kandi ntibyatera abana impanuka igihe babikoresha

The kitchen area is not accessible by children unless it is being used solely for a supervised children’s activity./ Abana ntibemerewe kujya mu gikoni keretse iyo hari igikorwa bakoreramo kiyobowe n’umurezi.

The facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote safety at household and facility level for children’s wellbeing./ Irerero rikorana bya hafi n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) ndetse n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze mu kubungabunga umutekano w’abana.

sections.title: 15. Positive discipline/ Gukosora umwana utamuhutaje

items.text: There are positive behaviour posters for reference by both children and caregivers./ Mu kigo hamanitse ibyapa bigaragaza imyitwarire myiza kugira ngo bibere ikitegererezo abana n’abarezi.
Caregivers for children are trained on children’s positive behaviour management/ Abarezi b’abana bahawe amahugurwa ku burezi budahutaza ndetse no ku micungire y’imyitwarire y’abana bato.
Caregivers conduct regular parenting education sessions on positive discipline./ Abarezi bategurira ababyeyi amasomo ahoraho ku bijyanye n’uburezi budahutaza.

sections.title: 16. Record Keeping/ Kubika Amakuru ku Bana

items.text: Accreditation certificate is available./ Kugaragaza icyemezo cyo kwemererwa gukora
There is an individual child information form completed, updated and kept confidential./ Buri mwana afite ifishi yuzuzwaho amakuru ye ahora avugururwa kandi ayo makuru akagirwa ibanga.
Health data are well documented and safely kept./ Amakuru ajyanye n’ubuzima bw’umwana arakusanywa akabikwa neza;
There is a record of the person designated to drop and collect each child. (Showing the list)/ Irerero ribika amakuru y’umuntu uzana umwana ku irerero akanamucyura.

There is a system for the exchange of information between parents and staff members. (Showing a group whatsap)/ Hashyirwaho uburyo ababyeyi n’abakozi b’irerero basangizanya amakuru areba umwana ku irerero cyangwa mu rugo.
An occurrence and action logbook/record is kept./ Habaho igitabo cyandikwamo ibikorwa byose byabaye mu irerero.

sections.title: 17. Education/ Uburezi

items.text: The national parenting curriculum and related guides are available and in use./ Integanyanyigisho ku burere butangirwa mu muryango ikoreshwa mu irerero kimwe n’izindi nyobora bijyana.
Early Learning and Development Standards (ELDS) are available and in proper use./ Kugira no gukoresha neza ibipimo ngenderwaho ku mikurire n’imyigire (ELDS).
Learning is holistic and creates opportunities for play-based inquiry and sensory stimulation./ Imyigire mu irerero komatanya, ishingiye ku mikino, ku bushakashatsi no gukangura ibyumviro.
There is a daily schedule of activities./ Irerero rifite gahunda y’ibikorwa by’umunsi

Caregivers are trained on the use of the national parenting curriculum and related guides./ Abarezi mu irerero bahuguwe ku mikoreshereze y’integanyanyigisho ku burere butangirwa mu miryango n’izindi nyandiko zijyanye na yo.
There is a learning environment/room well equipped and attractive./ Hari icyumba giteguye gifasha umwana gukangura ubwonko, kwiga no gukura mu buryo bukomatanyije.

facilityTypes.title: B. Self-Evaluation Tool for Home-Based ECD Facilities

sections.title: 1. Information about establishment/Imiterere y’urugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: The household was selected by parents themselves. / Ababyeyi ubwabo bahitamo urugo ruzatangirwamo serivisi mbonezamikurire.

The parent hosting the facility has signed a consent form. /Umubyeyi umwe cyangwa bombi igihe bahari umugabo n’umugore basinyira ko bemeye ko urugo rwabo ruzajya rutangirwamo serivisi mbonezamikurire ku buntu.
The selected home has been approved by the local authorities. / Urugo rwatoranyijwe rwemejwe n’urwego rw’ibanze ku rwego rw’akagari.
The household can accommodate children with disabilities. /Urugo mbonezamikurire ntiruheza abana bafite ubumuga n’abandi bana bafite ibibazo byihariye.

sections.title: 2. Information about Leadership and Management/Imiyoborere y’urugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: The facility is led by a parent leader/the host/ Urugo mbonezamikurire ruyoborwa n’umubyeyi watoranyijwe mu bandi baturutse mu ngo zigize iryo tsinda cyangwa nyir’urugo.

There is a work rotation setting out the times when each parent is responsible for childcare at the facility. /Hashyizweho gahunda y’uburyo ababyeyi bazajya basimburana mu guha abana serivisi z’imbonezamikurire.
Two parents are on duty every day, offering ECD services to children./ Buri munsi haba hari ababyeyi 2 bashinzwe kwita ku bana kuri serivise zose z’imbonezamikurire.
Any child aged 3–5 years may be enrolled./ Abana bafite imyaka 3-6 bakirwa mu rugo mbonezamikurire nta mpamvu ishingiweho.
The facility provides services for approximately 15 children from neighbouring households. /Urugo mbonezamikurire ruha serivisi z’imbonezamikurire abana batarenze 15 baturutse mu ngo z’abaturanyi.
Parents have been trained how to provide integrated ECD services. /Ababyeyi b’abana bahabwa amahugurwa y’uburyo baha abana babo serivisi mbonezamikurire zikomatanyije.
A written daily routine is available and followed. /Hari gahunda y’umunsi y’ibikorwa ishushanyije.
Minimum working hours are 4 hours per day for 5 days. /Amasaha make abana bagomba kumara mu rugo mbonezamikurire ni 4 mu gihe k’iminsi 5.
Children’s daily attendance is recorded in a register. /Hari igitabo cyangwa ikayi yo guhamagariramo abana baje
Parents’ meetings are conducted once a term. /Inama z’ababyeyi ziterana nibura rimwe mu gihembwe.

sections.title: 3. Information about Curriculum and Learning Approaches /Integanyanyigisho n’imyigire mu rugo mbonezamikurire.

items.text: The national parenting curriculum and related guides are used. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukoresha integanyanyigisho y’Uburere Buboneye.
The pre-primary CBC is followed. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukoresha integanyanyigisho y’amashuri y’inshuke ishingiye ku bushobozi.
Parents have been trained how to use the national parenting curriculum and preprimary CBC. /Ababyeyi bahugurwa ku mukoreshereze y’integanyanyigisho y’amashuri y’inshuke n’iy’Uburere Buboneye.

Parents have been trained how to make play materials using locally available resources. /Ababyeyi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo gukora ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho bakoresheje ibikoresho biboneka aho urugo ruherereye.
Parents have been trained how to support learning through play using locally produced materials. /Ababyeyi bahugurwa ku bijyanye no kuyobora ibikorwa by’imyigire n’imyigishirize binyuze mu mikino.
Parents have been trained how to set up learning corners /Ababyeyi bahugurwa ku bijyanye no gutegura inguni zo kwigiramo no kuzikoresha neza.

sections.title: 4. Information about Health/Ubuzima

items.text: Caregivers check the immunization status of children. (proof needed)/ Umurezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire asuzuma uko abana bafata inking.
CHWs visit the facility. (Proof of signature by CHW)/ Umujyanama w’ubuzima asura urugo mbonezamikurire kugira ngo arebe ibibazo bijyanye n’ubuzima abana bafite.
Records are kept of children and their health status. (proof of those records) Umurezi yandika abana n’ibibazo bagiye bagira iyo abakira.
Children have medical insurance (proof needed)/ Umurezi agenzura ko abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza.
Children are regularly monitored for health and growth by a local CHW. (Proof of report) /Umujyanama w’ubuzima akurikirana mu buryo buhoraho ko abana bakura neza.

The facility works with CHW, IZU and local authorities. (Proof of signature upon visits or scheduled visits)/ Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorana bya hafi n’umujyanama w’ubuzima, Inshuti z’Umuryango, n’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze.

sections.title: 5. Information about Nutrition/Imirire mu rugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: There is a kitchen to prepare porridge for the children. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rwatoranyijwe rufite igikoni gitegurirwamo igikoma cy’abana /amafunguro.
Children are always supervised by an adult when eating. /Igihe abana bafata igikoma baba bagenzurwa n’umuntu mukuru.
The parent caregivers have been trained on food hygiene and safety. /Abarezi bahuguwe ku bijyanye n’umutekano n’isuku y’ibiribwa.
The parent caregivers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and covering their hair. /Abarezi bahorana isuku: gukaraba intoki no gupfuka imisatsi igihe bategura amafunguro.

Parent caregivers report children with feeding difficulties to their parents for appropriate action. /Abarezi bamenya abana bafite ibibazo bijyanye n’amafunguro bakabibwira ababyeyi kugira ngo bagire icyo babikoraho.

sections.title: 6. Information about Child Protection and Safety/Umutekano no kurinda umwana

items.text: Parent caregivers have been trained on relevant health and safety issues./ Abarezi bahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye n’ubuzima, umutekano w’abana mu rugo mbonezamikurire
Health facility and parents’ phone numbers are available to call in case of emergency. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rwabitse inomero za terefone z’ivuriro n’iz’ababyeyi zahamagarwa hari ikibazo kibaye.
Children are supervised by adults while playing. /Abana bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru igihe bakina.
An enclosed compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound. /Ingarani/ikimoteri bamenamo imyanda icukuye kure y’aho abana bakinira kandi iratwikiriye.
Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children’s reach. /Ibikoresho byose byateza abana impanuka/byabakomeretsa bibitse kure aho badashobora kugera
All pits in the home compound are covered for safety./ Ibyobo byose bicukuye mu rugo birapfundikiye ku bw’umutekano w’abana
Measures are taken to prevent children from accessing the kitchen alone. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rushyiraho ingamba zikumira abana kujya mu gikoni bari bonyine.
The household is fenced, secure and clean to allow children to play and learn. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rurazitiye, rufite umutekano n’isuku ku buryo abana bakina kandi bakiga batekanye.
Where there is electricity, measures are taken to protect children from electric shock/Aho urugo rufite amashanyarazi, hashyirwaho ingamba zo kurinda abana impanuka z’amashanyarazi.

sections.title: 7. Information about WASH/Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura

items.text: Clean water is available for caregivers and children to wash hands. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite amazi meza ku buryo abarezi n’abana bakaraba intoki.
There is running water on the premises or at a public water point no more than 500 m away. /Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari amazi ya robine cyangwa ivomo rya rusange riri hafi nko muri metero 500
Potable water is used to prepare porridge. /Hari amazi meza yo gutekesha igikoma/amafunguro
Children have clean clothes./ Abana bambara imyenda ifite isuku
There is a clean, child-friendly toilet./ Urugo rufite umusarani ufite isuku kandi ujyanye n’ikigero cy’abana.
A container with safe drinking water is available and kept covered. /Hari igikoresho kigenewe kubika amazi yo kunywa gipfundikirwa.
Potholes and bushes in the household compound are cleared. /Ibihuru n’ibyobo bireka amazi mu rugo byakuweho
Waste bins are available to avoid rubbish being scattered around the compound. /Hari igikoresho cyo kumenamo imyanda kugira ngo imyanda itanyanyagira mu rugo hose

sections.title: 8. Information about Recruitment/Selection and qualification of caregivers /Uko abarezi bashyirwaho mu rugo mbonezamikurire n’impamyabushobozi zabo.

items.text: A caregiver has one of the following qualifications: Umurezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire afite impamyabushobozi imwe muri izi zikurikira:

indicators.label: a) Ordinary secondary school level certificate with intensive training in ECD/Kuba yarize ikiciro cya mbere cy’amashuri yisumbuye (O’Level), akaba yaranahawe amahugurwa yimbitse ku mbonezamikurire y’abana bato
b) Primary-level certificate with intensive training in ECD/Kuba yarize amashuri abanza (Primary Education) akaba yaranahawe amahugurwa yimbitse ku mbonezamikurire y’abana bato.
c) Experienced and trained on ECD by NCDA, Districts and partners. /Kuba afite uburambe mu kwita ku bana bato kandi yaranahuguwe na NCDA, REB, Akarere n’abafatanyabikorwa (DPs)

items.text: A parent committee of ECD settings selects the caregivers. /Gutoranya umurezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire bikorwa n’ababyeyi

facilityTypes.title: C. ECD Mapping Tool for Community-Based ECD Facilities

sections.title: 1. Information about Geographical Location/Aho urugo rukorera

items.text: The facility has access to the road./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rugeraho umuhanda.
The distance from home to the facility does not exceed 500 m. /Urugendo abana bakora kuva mu rugo iwabo kugera ku rugo mbonezamikurire ntirurenga metero 500
Children are accompanied by an adult to and from school. /Umwana agera ku rugo mbonezamikurire akanataha aherekejwe n’umuntu mukuru.
The facility is recognized by local authorities. /Aho urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera hazwi n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze.

There is a primary school close to the facility to ease transition from pre-school to primary education. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite ishuri ribanza hafi kugira ngo bizorohere abana bahiga gukomeza mu mashuri abanza.

sections.title: 2. Information about Physical Environment/Imiterere y’aho urugo rukorera

items.text: The compound and surrounding areas are free from harmful objects, rubbish and have proper disposal for trash. /Mu rugo imbere n’ahahakikije hafite umutekano, nta bintu byakwangiza abana bihari nk’ibintu bityaye cyangwa ibyatsi bihumanya.
The playground is dry, not waterlogged. /Ikibuga abana bakiniraho kirumutse nta mazi aretsemo.
All wells and pits are properly covered. /Ibyobo by’amazi byose bipfundikiye neza.
Water containers and clean drinking water are available. /Urugo rufite ibikoresho bibikwamo amazi yo kunywa.
There are facilities to harvest rainwater. /Urugo rufite ibikoresho bifata amazi y’imvura.
The facility has an electricity supply. /Urugo rufite amashanyarazi kugira ngo byoroshye ikoranabuhanga mu myigishirize.
Buildings and equipment are accessible by all children /Inyubako n’ibikoresho ntabwo biheza abana n’abakozi bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 3. Information about Classroom/Indoor space/Ibyumba byigirwamo

items.text: At least three classrooms are available for a complete cycle: Grade 1, Grade 2 and Grade 3./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite nibura ibyumba bitatu bijyanye n’imyaka y’abana: umwaka wa 1, umwaka wa 2, umwaka wa 3
Classrooms are clean, dust-free and have at least one rubbish bin per classroom. /Icyumba kigirwamo kirasukuye, nta vumbi ririmo kandi gifite igikoresho bashyiramo imyanda

Classrooms are child friendly: age-appropriate, visually stimulating with meaningful decorations, engaging and culturally appropriate. /Ibyumba byigirwamo bijyanye nimyaka y’abana, bitatse ku buryo bikurura abana bikabashishikariza gukora.
The play and learning rooms have cement/tiled/ sealed earthen floor and are cleaned every day. /Icyumba cyo kwigiramo no gukiniramo gishashe neza, kirimo isima cyangwa kirakurungiye.
The roof is made of tiles or iron sheets. /Igisenge gisakaje amabati cyangwa amategura.

Each classroom has two windows at least 1 m x 1 m in opposite walls to allow enough light and ventilation. /Buri cyumba cyo kwigiramo gifite amadirishya abiri ya metero kuri metero kugira ngo abana babone urumuri n’umwuka bihagije

Classrooms are accessible for use by children with special needs, and have ramps, rails and lower door handles. /Icyumba cyo kwigiramo ntigifite ingazi (esikariye) kugira ngo byorohere abana bose kwinjira no gusohoka
A caregiver’s chair, table and cupboard are available. /Mu cyumba kigirwamo harimo intebe n’ameza by’umurezi.

Indoor space allows free movement between furniture for mobility-aid users and children with visual impairment./ Mu cyumba kigirwamo hari umwanya uhagije hagati y’intebe kugira ngo byorohere abana kwinyagambura cyane abafite ubumuga.
Tables and benches/chairs are child age-appropriate./ Intebe n’ameza bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana, biraramba, kandi bisize amarangi y’amabara atandukanye

Mats are available in each classroom for activities such as reading, storytelling, and play, corner play, theme display, group work etc. Umusambi/umukeka uteguye mu ishuri kugira ngo abana bakorereho ibikorwa bitandukanye byo gusoma, kubara inkuru, n’indi mikino.
Open shelves, cupboards, boxes or other containers are used to store learning materials./ Etajeri, akabati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa mu kubika ibikinisho n’izindi mfashanyigisho
The classroom has enough bag/clothes hooks for children. /Buri cyumba kigirwamo gifite aho kumanika imipira, n’ibikapu by’abana.

A chalkboard or similar large writing surface (movable or fixed) is placed slightly above the floor (20 cm) for children to access it easily. /Ikibaho gitereye kuri santimetero 20 uvuye ku butaka kugira ngo abana bose bashobore kugikoresha.
A sleeping space is reserved in one corner of the classroom for special cases. /Mu cyumba kigirwamo hateganyijwe aho umwana ugize ikibazo yaryama bibaye ngombwa n’ibiryamirwa by’ingenzi.

sections.title: 4. Information about Kitchen/Igikoni

items.text: The kitchen roof is made of durable materials (tiles or iron sheets). /Igikoni gisakaje amabati cyangwa amategura
The cooking place is at least 2 m x 2 m and uses an economical stove./ Icyumba cyo gutekeramo gifite nibura metero 2 kuri metero 2 kandi hakoreshwa amashyiga ya rondereza.
The cooking area is clean and tidy./ Aho batekera hahora hasukuye kandi hatunganyije.
The kitchen is supplied with clean water. /Igikoni gifite amazi meza. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bogerezamo ibyombo
The kitchen has a place for washing utensils. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bogerezamo ibyombo.
Utensils are kept safely in a clean, covered container. / Ibikoresho byo mu gikoni bibikwa mu kintu gipfundikirwa.
Plastic items are not used for hot food or drinks. / Ibikoresho bya purasitike ntabwo byemewe ku biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa bishyushye cyane.
Kitchen has a table or shelf as a drying area for dishes after washing. / Igikoni gifite ahantu ho kumukiriza amasahani, ibiyiko n’amakanya nyuma yo kubyoza.
Kitchen is separate from classrooms and toilets./ Igikoni kitaruye amashuri n’imisarani.
Kitchen is ventilated and well-lit. / Igikoni gifite umwuka uhagije, urumuri ruhagije kandi gifite umuyoboro usohora umwotsi hanze.
The floor slopes slightly to ease cleaning. / Hasi mu gikoni hacuritse buhoro kugira ngo byorohe kuhakorera isuku bakoropa amazi.
Waste disposal facilities are in place. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bigenewe gushyiramo imyanda

sections.title: 5. Information about Toilets/Ubwiherero

items.text: There are separate toilets/latrines for boys and girls, clearly labelled with child-friendly signs. /Imisarani y’abakobwa itandukanyijwe n’iy’abahungu hifashishijwe amagambo n’amashusho ku buryo byorohera abana kuyitandukanya.
There are separate male and female lockable toilets for adults. /Abantu bakuru bafite umusarani wabo kandi urakingwa, abagabo bafite uwabo n’abagore uwabo

Latches (locks) inside and outside are fixed at the height of 60-80 cm from bottom for children’s easy access. /Icyo bakingisha inyuma n’imbere gitereye kuri cm 60-80 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana bashobore kuhagera biboroheye

There is a pictorial and printed hand-wash sign on each toilet/latrine door to remind children and caregivers to wash hands with water and soap after using the toilet./ Hari ishusho/ifoto cyangwa inyandiko yibutsa abana n’abandi bantu gukaraba intoki n’amazi n’isabune nyuma yo gukoresha ubwiherero

The handwashing facility is near the toilet, of age-appropriate design and installed at the height of 50 cm measured from the floor./ Igikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri ku kigero cy’abana kandi biri kuri cm 50 uvuye hasi

sections.title: 6. Information about Outdoor Play area and Equipment/Aho abana bakinira hanze n’ibikoresho by’imikino.

items.text: There is an outdoor play area./ Hanze aho abana bakinira harasukuye kandi nta byakwangiza abana bihari

There is safe outdoor play equipment and materials for motor skills and holistic development: rubber swing, seesaw, slides, swings, merry-go-round, sandbox, set of tyres etc./ Hanze hari ibikoresho by’imikino bifasha abana mu miyego itandukanye n’imikurire mu ngeri zose.

Outdoor play areas have enough space between play equipment to enable mobility aid users to move freely and safely. /Hanze aho abana bakinira abarezi bagenzura ko ibikoresho by’imikino bitabuza abana kwinyagambura cyane abafite ubumuga.
Child-friendly fixed equipment includes low slides and logs to walk on, ladders, tunnels etc. /Ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana nk’imyicungo n’ibyo bagenderaho, n’ibindi.
Movable play materials include ropes, balls, tyres, hoops etc./ Hari ibikinisho byimukanwa bigizwe n’imigozi, imipira, amapine, ibiziga, n’ibindi.
There is a sandpit for sand play activities. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite icyobo kirimo umucanga wo gukiniramo n’ibikoresho bitandukanye byo gukinisha mu mucanga

There is a water play area with recycled containers, hoses/water pipes and other world discovery tools. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite aho abana bakinira n’amazi bifashishije ibikoresho bitandukanye bituma bavumbura ibintu byinshi ku mazi.

Play materials are smooth and undamaged, with no sharp edges or protruding surfaces. /Ibikinisho bifite ubuso bunyerera, butabyimbye, imigongo idatyaye, ku buryo bitangiza abana mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Jumping, climbing and sliding areas should be covered with soft ground, sand or grass. /Aho abana basimbukira, aho bazamukira ku ngazi, aho bicungira hari itaka ryoroshye, umucanga cyangwa ibyatsi
There is play equipment for children with disabilities. /Hari ibikinisho by’abana bafite ubumuga
Locally made play and learning materials and toys are available. /Uretse ibikinisho bigurwa byakorewe mu nganda, hari n’ibikinisho byakozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho urugo mbonezamikurire ruherereye.

sections.title: 7. Information about Health Practices and Procedures/Ubuzima

items.text: Children aged 3–5 years are screened for developmental delay/ disability by community health workers, or early detection by parents, health professionals./ Abana kuva ku myaka 3- 5 barasuzumwe hagamijwe kureba abafite cyangwa bafite ibyago byo kugira ibibazo by’idindira mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

Children’s registration forms are available with information on identification, health status, contact information of parents/ guardians, and any parental concerns./ Amafishi y’umwana harimo ifishi igaragaza umwirondoro w’umwana, ubuzima bwe, ifishi y’ikingira, terefone z’ababyeyi ndetse n’ibindi bibazo ababyeyi bazi ku mwana birahari.
Immunization cards are used during registration of children. /Ifishi y’ikingira yifashishwa mu gihe cyo kwandika umwana
The facility has a health worker’s contact for health-related issues. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite inomero za terefone z’umujyanama w’ubuzima zitabazwa bibaye ngombwa.
The facility has information about children with medical insurance. /Urugo rufite amakuru y’abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza.

Guidelines with pictures on how to manage communicable disease outbreaks or promote good practices such as handwashing are posted. /Amabwiriza ajyanye n’uko abantu birinda indwara zandura, ibyorezo, gukaraba intoki aramanitse kandi aherekejwe n’amashusho abisobanura.
Children are regularly monitored for healthy growth by the local CHW and/or health professionals. /Ubuzima bw’abana bukurikiranwa n’umujyanama w’ubuzima.

The facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote safety at household and facility levels for children’s wellbeing. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorana cyane n’Inshuti z’Umuryango n’anabayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze.

The Ministry of Health, through CHWs, regularly administers deworming pills to children. /Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ibinyujije ku bajyanama b’ubuzima igenera abana imiti y’inzoka ku buryo buhoraho mu ngo mbonezamikurire.

sections.title: 8. Information about Food and Nutrition Practices/Imirire

items.text: There is a kitchen to prepare children’s meals. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite igikoni gitegurirwamo amafunguro y’abana igihe bari ku kigo.
During mealtimes, children are always supervised by an adult. /Mu gihe cyo gufata amafunguro, abana bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru.
Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety. /Abatetsi n’abandi bafite aho bahurira n’ibiribwa bahorana isuku, bakaraba intoki bakanambara ingofero

Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and cover their hair. /Abatetsi cyangwa abandi bantu bafite aho bahurira n’ibyo kurya bahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye no gutegura amafunguro afite isuku.

sections.title: 9. Information about child protection and safety Practices /Umutekano no kurinda umwana.

items.text: All staff receive regular training on relevant health and safety issues./ Abakozi bose bahabwa amahugurwa ahoraho ku bijyanye n’ubuzima n’umutekano w’abana bibera mu kigo mbonezamikurire.

Outdoor play equipment is maintained regularly to ensure it is in good condition and safe for children. /Ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze nk’imyicungo n’aho bakinira mu mucanga bihora bisuzumwa kandi bikitabwaho kugira ngo hagenzurwe niba nta mpanuka byateza abana.
There are firefighting facilities on the premises. /Hari ibikoresho byakwifashishwa mu gihe habaye inkongi y’umuriro

Where there is electricity, covered sockets are used to protect children from electric shock. /Aho urugo mbonezamikurire rufite umuriro w’amashanyarazi, aho bacomekera ibikoresho hakoreshwa ibikoresho byabugenwe bidatuma abana binjizamo ibintu uko biboneye.
First aid kit and any medicines are kept out of children’s reach./ Hari agasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze n’imiti ibamo bibikwa kure aho abana bategera.

All ECD service providers are trained how to use the contents of the first aid box and how to deal with accidents. /Abatanga serivisi z’imbonezamikurire bose bahuguwe ku bijyanye no gukoresha ibiri mu gasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze n’uburyo bakwitwara mu gihe abana bagize impanuka.
Illustrated guidelines on how to prevent accidents and deal with emergencies are posted. /Amabwiriza yo kwirinda impanuka n’uko wakwitwara mu gihe k’ibiza aramanitse kandi aherekejwe n’ibishushanyo.
Emergency telephone numbers are available. /Nimero za terefone zihamagarwa mu gihe habaye impanuka ikomeye cyangwa ikindi cyago zimanitse ahantu abakozi bose bazibona byoroshye.
Children are supervised by an adult when playing outside. /Abana bafite umuntu ubakurikirana igihe bakina hanze./ Abana bafite umuntu ubakurikirana igihe bakina hanze.

Measures preventing corporal punishment and abuse are established and communicated to school staff and parents./ Ingamba zibuza ibihano bibabaza umubiri n’ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana zashyizweho kandi zimenyeshwa abakozi bose b’urugo mbonezamikurire ndetse n’ababyeyi.

Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children’s reach (e.g. knives, petrol, gas, cleaning solutions, construction leftovers etc.)/ Ibikoresho byateza impanuka bibitswe kure aho abana batagera.

All toys for younger children are non-toxic and oversized so that children cannot swallow or choke on them, or put them in their ears. /Ibikinisho byose bigenewe abana bato ntibisize irangi ryakwangiza abana baramutse babishyize mu kanwa
An enclosed compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound. /Icyobo kijugunywamo imyanda kirikure y’aho abana bakinira kandi kiratwikiriye kubera umutekano w’abana.

sections.title: 10. Information about WASH Practices/Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura

items.text: Containers with safe drinking water and a cup for each child are available and cleaned regularly. /Hari ibikoresho bibika amazi yo kunywa kandi bigirirwa isuku ku buryo buhoraho
Clean water is always available for caregivers and children to wash their hands./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite amazi meza yo gukaraba mu ntoki no gutegura amafunguro.
There is running water in the premises or at a public water point no further than 500 m away./ Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari isoko y’amazi cyangwa amazi aboneka nibura muri metero 500 uvuye ku rugo
Clean, functioning toilets are available all times. /Hari gahunda ihoraho y’isuku kugira ngo ubwiherero buhorane isuku.
Children have clean clothes and shoes. /Abana bafite imyambaro ifite isuku kandi bambara inkweto.

A water container with clean water and soap is available in the classroom, toilets, kitchen and any other place necessary. /Ibikoresho bibika amazi n’isabune birahari kugira ngo byifashishwe mu isuku yo mu mashuri, mu misarani, mu gikoni n’ahandi hantu mu kigo.
Mobile handwashing stations (kandagira ukarabe) are available near the toilets./ Ibikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri hafi y’ubwiherero.

Adequate, enclosed waste disposal facilities (rubbish pit, waste bin or any other mode of garbage) are available and regularly emptied. /Hari ibikoresho byabugenwe byo gushyiramo imyanda, bividurwa ku gihe kandi bigapfundikirwa ku bw’umutekano w’abana.
Bushes, potholes and pools of water around the facility are cleared to deter snakes and mosquitoes. /Ibihuru n’ibizenga by’amazi byakuweho kugira ngo bitaba indiri y’inzoka n’imibu.
There are educational posters on the importance of handwashing and balanced diet. /Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari icyapa kigisha abana ibijyanye no gukaraba intoki ndetse n’indyo yuzuye.
All WASH facilities are accessible by children with disabilities. /Ibikoresho by’amazi, isuku n’isukura ntibiheza abana bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 11. Information about Organisation of Teaching and Learning Activities/Play activities/Kuyobora ibikorwa by’imyigire n’imyigishirize.

items.text: Activities are planned around the six learning areas of the pre-primary curriculum. /Abana bakoraibikorwa biteza imbere ubushobozi mu byigwa bitandatu by’integanyanyigisho.
Children are engaged in activities that develop fine motor and pre-writing skills./ Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bibafasha kuzamura ubushobozi bwo gukoresha intoki n’ibibategura kwandika.
Daily schedule is at least 4 hours. /Gahunda y’ibikorwa by’umunsi imara nibura amasaha 4.
Facilities follow REB proposed schedule (the same as in school-based ECDs). /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu rukurikiza ingengabihe yatanzwe na REB na NCDA

Children with sensory impairment have access to materials that maximize their capabilities e.g. large-print, high contrast etc. /Abana bafite ubumuga mu byumviro bitandukanye bafite ibikoresho bibafasha kubona amakuru ashoboka ku mfashanyigisho ku byigwa bitandukanye.

The daily schedule balances and alternates activities: quiet-noisy; indoor-outdoor, active-passive; large group-small group etc. /Gahunda y’umunsi igenda isimburanya ibikorwa: ibikorwa bituje-ibisaba kuvuga, ibyo mu nzu n’ibyo hanze,…
The classroom encourages children to play with a range of materials. /Uburyo ishuri riteguye bukurura abana kandi bushishikariza gukinisha ibikinisho bitandukanye

Children’s original drawings, writing and other work are displayed on the walls at their eye level. /Ibishushanyo by’abana, inyandiko zabo n’ibindi bikorwa byabo bimanikwa ku rukuta rw’ishuri aho biborohera kubirebaho.
An adult/caregiver supervises the sharing of outdoor play equipment. /Hari umuntu mukuru cyangwa umurezi ufasha abana gusangira ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze.

The facility applies UDL principles (proof in lesson plans or daily and weekly plans) /Ibikorwa bya buri munsi, uburyo bw’imyigishirize, aho abana bigira, ibikoresho bakoresha, ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho byimakaza amahame y’uburezi budaheza.

sections.title: 12. Information about Teaching and Learning Resources/Imfashanyigisho z’imyigire n’imyigishirize

items.text: Every ECD provider delivers services based on the REB and NCDA approved curriculum for children aged 3–6 years./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite integanyanyigisho zemejwe n’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB) n’Ikigo k’Igihugu Gishinzwe Imikurire no Kurengera Umwana (NCDA).

There are appropriate learning materials for all learning areas: Discovery of the world, Numeracy, Languages, Creative Art and Craft, Physical development and Health, Social and emotional learning./ Hariibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho kuri buri kigwa k’integanyanyigisho.
Children’s writing materials: books, writing materials like pens, pencils, chalks, crayons, paper, and notebooks are available./ Abana bafite ibikoresho byo kwandikisha n’ibyo kwandikaho.

Materials used in pre-primary are locally available, culturally acceptable, age appropriate, inclusive, durable, safe and clean, attractive etc./ Imfashanyigisho zikoreshwa mu ngo mbonezamikurire akenshi zikozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho urugo ruherereye, zijyanye n’umuco w’abana, ziri ku kigero cy’abana.

Play materials are appropriate to the local context and imitate games children play at home. /Imfashanyigisho n’ibikinisho zijyanye n’ubuzima abana babayemo kandi zisanisha n’imikino abana bakina iyo bari mu rugo.
Textbooks and other approved documents are available. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite ibitabo, ibitabo by’inyongera byo gusoma n’izindi nyandiko zemejwe.

sections.title: 13. Information about Establishment, Registration and Accreditation/ Gutangiza no kwandikisha urugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: The facility is registered. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu ruranditswe.
The facility is accredited /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite uruhushya rwo gukora

sections.title: 14. Information about Management of a Community-Based ECD facility/Imicungire y’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote.

items.text: Children enroll in Grade 1 when they are 3 years old or will turn 3 in the first trimester./ Abana bemerewe kujya mu rugo mbonezamikurire mu mwaka wa mbere ni abafite imyaka 3 cyangwa abazayuzuza mu gihembwe cya mbere
Parents/guardians were involved in setting up the facility./ Ababyeyi bagize uruhare mu ishingwa ry’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu.

Children are registered using immunization cards or birth certificates./ Amafishi y’ikingira cyangwa ibyemezo by’amavuko ni byo bishingirwaho bakira abana aho gushingira ku bizamini bihabwa abana kugira ngo bemererwe

Management is under the parents general assembly, the ECD executive committee, control committee and advisory committee./ Ubuyobozi bw’urugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu bugizwe n’inama rusange y’ababyeyi, komite nyobozi, komite ngenzuzi, na komite ngishwanama.
All parents/guardians meet in a general assembly at least once a term./ Ababyeyi bose bahurira mu nama rusange nibura rimwe mu gihembwe.

In collaboration with ECD frontliners, the service provider ensures that children at risk of developmental delay or disability are enrolled./ Ku bufatanye n’abakorerabushake bashinzwe imbonezamikurire y’abana bato mu nzego z’ibanze (ECD frontliners), abana bafite idindira mu mikurire n’abafite ubumuga barandikwa.

sections.title: 15. Information about Recruitment and qualification of caregivers/Ishyirwa mu kazi ku barezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu.

items.text: Caregivers have one of the following qualifications:/ Impamyabushobozi ishingirwaho ni imwe muri izi zikurikira:

indicators.label: • Secondary certificate (S6) with training in ECD by REB, NCDA, district or development partners. /A2 ECE/ECLPE yatanzwe n’Ishuri Nderabarezi (TTC)

• Secondary certificate (S6) with training in ECD by REB, NCDA, district or development partners./ Nibura amashuri 6 yisumbuye (A2) no kuba yarahawe amahugurwa ku bijyanye n’imbonezamikurire y’abana bato yateguwe na REB, NCDA, Akarere, Abafatanyabikorwa.

• Secondary certificate (S6) in general education or associate nursing graduates plus at least 2 years’ experience in pre-primary teaching and childcare./Amashuri yisumbuye (S6) mu bumenyi rusange cyangwa ubuforomo n’uburambe bw’imyaka nibura ibiri yigisha mu ngo mbonezamikurire.

items.text: Caregivers are continuously trained, mentored as needed through CPD. /Abarezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire bahora bahugurwa, bagirwa inama igihe cyose bikenewe binyuze muri gahunda y’amahugurwa ahoraho (CPDs).
A parent committee selects the caregivers for the facility. /Guhitamo abarezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire bikorwa na komite y’ababyeyi
