sections.title: 2. Geographical location/Aho ruherereye

items.text: There is access to the road/Urugo rukora ku muhanda
Children live within 2 km of the facility./ Urugo rwakira abana baturuka mu ntera itarenga kirometero 2
The facility is close to a primary school (within 2 km)/ Hari ishuri ribanza hafi y’urugo mbonezamikurire.
There is no excessive noise in the surroundings (workshop, industrial parks and markets)/ Aho ruherereye nta rusaku rukabije ruhari
The facility is recognized by local leaders. /Urugo mbonezamikurire ruzwi n’inzego z’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze.
The facility is close to a health centre (within 2 km)/ Hari ivuriro hafi y’urugo mbonezamikurire

sections.title: 2. Preschool physical environment/Imiterere y’aho urugo rukorera

items.text: The facility is fenced and has a lockable gate /Urugo mbonezamikurire rurazitiye kandi amarembo yarwo arafungwa
The compound and surroundings are clean./ Urugo gifite isuku mo imbere n’ahagikikije
The buildings are safe and disability-friendly /Inyubako zacyo nta mpanuka zateza kandi ntiziheza abana bafite ubumuga.
The playground is dry, not waterlogged /Ikibuga abana bakiniraho kirumutse nta mazi aretsemo
Play materials are appropriate to children’s age./ Ibikinisho bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana.
There are signs that prohibit smoking and alcohol consumption within the premises by staff members and visitors./ Hari icyapa kibuza abantu gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge mu rugo mbonezamikurire.
There are no footpaths crossing the facility. /Nta nzira y’abanyamaguru yambukiranya urugo.
There are water collection facilities (rain or from the Water and Sanitation Corporation, WASAC). / Hari ibikoresho bifata amazi y’imvura cyangwa aya WASAC.
The facility has electricity. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite amashanyarazi

sections.title: 3. Classroom/Indoor space /Ibyumba byo kwigiramo

items.text: There are three classrooms – for Grade 1, Grade 2, and Grade 3. /Urugo rufite ibyumba byo kwigiramo bitatu bihwanye n’imyaka y’inshuke: umwaka wa 1, 2, 3.

Children enroll in Grade one at the age of 3 years or if their third birthday falls in the first trimester. /Abana bemererwa kujya mu mwaka wa mbere ni abujuje imyaka 3 cyangwa bazayuzuza mu gihembwe cya mbere.
The walls and roof are built in durable materials./ Inkuta n’igisenge byubakishije ibikoresho biramba.
Enrolment for each early classroom does not exceed 30 children (Caregiver-child ratio)/ Umubare w’abana mu cyumba nturenga 30.

Indoor space allows free movement between furniture for mobility-aid users and children with visual impairment./ Mu cyumba kigirwamo hari umwanya uhagije hagati y’intebe kugira ngo byorohere abana bafite ubumuga kwinyagambura.

Each classroom has two windows at least 1m x 1m to allow enough light and ventilation. /Buri cyumba kigirwamo gifite amadirishya abiri ya metero kuri metero kugira ngo abana babone urumuri n’umwuka bihagije.

Classrooms are accessible for use by children with special needs, and have ramps, rails and lower door handles. /Icyumba cyo kwigiramo ntigifite ingazi (esikariye) kugira ngo byorohere abana bose kwinjira no gusohoka.

The classrooms are child-friendly, with age-appropriate, visually stimulating and meaningful decorations. /Ibyumba abana bigiramo bijyanye n’imyaka yabo, bitatse ku buryo bikurura abana bikanabashishikariza gukora.
The facility has a store for teaching, learning and other materials./ Etajeri, akabati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa mu kubika ibikinisho n’izindi mfashanyigisho.

Drawings and other materials displayed on the wall are hung at an appropriate height (20 cm from floor) so that children can see them easily. / Ibishushanyo n’izindi mfashanyigisho bikwiye kuba bimanitse guhera muri sentimetero 20 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana babirebeho bitabagoye.

sections.title: 4. Furniture/Intebe n’Ameza

items.text: Tables and benches/chairs are age appropriate (30cm high), durable and painted in bright colours./ Ameza n’intebe bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana (ubuhagarike bwa cm30), biraramba, kandi bisize amarangi y’amabara atandukanye.
A caregiver’s chair, table and cupboard are available in each classroom./ Mu cyumba abana bigiramo cyangwa mu biro by’umuyobozi hari intebe n’ameza.

Mats and child-friendly tables are available in each classroom for activities such as reading, storytelling, and play, corner play, theme display, group work etc./ Umusambi/umukeka uteguye mu ishuri kugira ngo abana bakorereho ibikorwa bitandukanye byo gusoma, kubara inkuru n’indi mikino.
Open shelves, cupboard, boxes or other containers are used to store learning materials./ Etajeri, akabati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoreshobikoreshwa mu kubika ibikinisho n’izindi mfashanyigisho.
Each class has enough bag/clothes hooks for children./ Buri cyumba kigirwamo gifite aho kumanika imipira, ibikapu by’abana.
The chalkboard/white board is placed slightly above the floor (20cm) for children to use easily./ Ikibaho gitereye kuri santimetero 20 uvuye ku butaka kugira ngo abana bose bashobore kugikoresha.

sections.title: 5. Kitchen /Igikoni

items.text: The cooking place is at least 2 m x 2 m and uses an economical stove or gas. /Ameza n’intebe bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana (ubuhagarike bwa cm30), biraramba, kandi bisize amarangi y’amabara atandukanye.
The kitchen has a sink for washing utensils /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bogerezamo ibyombo
The kitchen has a supply of clean water./ Igikoni gifite amazi meza
Plastic containers (plates and cups) are not used for hot food or drinks. /Ibikoresho bya purasitike ntibikoreshwa ku biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa bishyushye cyane.
Waste disposal facilities are in place. /Igikoni gifite ibikoresho bigenewe gushyiramo imyanda.
Kitchen has a drying area for dishes after washing. /Igikoni gifite ahantu ho kumukiriza amasahani, ibiyiko n’amakanya nyuma yo kubyoza.
Kitchen is separated from classrooms and toilets. / Igikoni kitaruye amashuri n’imisarani.
The kitchen is ventilated, well-lit and equipped with a chimney./Igikoni gifite umwuka n’urumuri bihagije kandi gifite umuyoboro usohora umwotsi hanze.

sections.title: 6. Kitchen Store/Ububiko bw’igikoni

items.text: The kitchen has a separate storage room./ Igikoni gifite icyumba kihariye kigenewe ububiko.
Kitchen store has locked cupboards for crockery, cooking utensils and stores of groceries and other consumables. /Ububiko bufite etajeri cyangwa akabati bifungwa
The storeroom is rodent- and insect-proof./ Inkuta no hasi mu bubiko nta myobo irimo kugira ngo hirindwe ibyonnyi n’udukoko twakwangiza ibiribwa.
Windows and other openings are covered with wire mesh./ Amadirishya y’ububiko n’amakositara atwikiriwe na senyenge /akayunguruzo.
A weighing scale is available. /Mu bubiko hari umunzani bapimiraho ibyo bagiye guteka.

sections.title: 7. Toilets/Latrines/Ubwiherero

items.text: There is at least one toilet/children latrine for every 40 children./ Umubare w’abana bakoresha umusarani umwe nturenga 40

There are separate child-friendly and accessible toilets/latrines for boys and for girls, clearly labelled with child friendly signs. /Imisarani iri ku kigero cy’abana kandi iy’abakobwa itandukanye n’iy’abahungu hifashishijwe amagambo n’amashusho ku buryo byorohera abana kuyitandukanya.
Adults have their own lockable toilets, separate for males and females. /Abantu bakuru bafite umusarani wabo kandi ukingwa abagabo bakagira uwabo n’abagore uwabo.

The toilet facility has a storage area to keep cleaning materials separately from other cleaning materials. /Ibikoresho by’isuku yo mu bwiherero bifite ububiko bwabyo bwihariye kugira ngo bitandukane n’ibindi bikoresho.
There is at least one toilet meeting the required standards for people with disabilities. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite nibura umusarani umwe ugenewe abantu bafite ubumuga.
Latches (locks) inside and outside are fixed at the height of 60-80 cm from bottom. /Icyo bakingisha inyuma n’imbere gitereye kuri cm 60-80 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana bashobore kuhagera biboroheye.
Toilets doors open outwards with 10 cm of free space between the floor and the door. /Urugi rw’ubwiherero rukingukira hanze kandi hari umwanya wa cm 10 kuva hasi kugera ku rugi.

Door height ranges from 100 to120 cm so that caregivers can open from outside if a child needs help. / Uburebure bw’urugi buri hagati ya cm100 na cm120 kugira ngo umurezi abe yafungura ari inyuma igihe umwana yahezemo imbere.
The diameter of a borehole in a pit latrine does not exceed 15 cm. /Umurambararo w’umwobo w’umusarani nturenga cm 15.
Toilets are close to classrooms for easy accessibility by young children. /Ubwiherero ntiburi kure y’ibyumba byigirwamokugira ngo byorohere abana kubugeraho.

There is a pictorial hand-wash sign on each toilet/latrine door to remind everyone to wash hands with water and soap after using the toilet./ Hari ishusho/ifoto cyangwa inyandiko yibutsa abana n’abandi gukaraba intoki.
There are urinals for boys set at a child appropriate height (30cm) from the floor. /Hari aho abahungu bihagarika hajyanye n’uburebure bw’abana nibura kuri cm 30 uvuye hasi.

The space inside the toilet is large enough to enable caregivers to bend over/move around to support the child. /Umwanya uri mu musarani imbere urahagije ku buryo umurezi yakwinjiranamo n’umwana akaba yakunama igihe afasha umwana.
The handwashing facility is age appropriate and installed at the height of 50 cm from the floor. /Igikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri ku kigero cy’abana kandi biri kuri cm 50 uvuye hasi
The pathways are clean and accessible by children with disabilities. /Inzira ijya ku misarani irapavomye cyangwa ishashemo amabuye/amatafari kandi ikoreshwa n’abana bose ndetse n’abafite ubuga.

sections.title: 8. Sleeping Area/ Aho abana baryama

items.text: The sleeping space is designed so that boys and girls can sleep separately. /Aho abana baryama hateguye mu buryo abahungu batandukana n’abakobwa.
The sleeping space is cemented/tiled/sealed earthen floor and cleaned every day. /Aho abana baryama hasi hakurungiye, harimo isima, cyangwa amakaro kandi hasukurwa buri munsi.

Furniture and walls are child-friendly (brightly painted with happy images)./ Inkuta z’aho abana baryama zikurura abana ni ukuvuga zisize amarangi abana bakunda, hariho ibishushanyo abana bakunda kandi mu cyumba harimo n’ibikinisho nk’ibipupe.

Furniture includes a mattress (covered with waterproof material), bed covers, bed sheets and storage space/shelves. /Ibikoresho by’aho abana baryama bigizwe na matera/umufariso ufubitse ikintu kitinjiza amazi. Ibitwikira uburiri nk’ikiringiti n’amashuka bihora bisukuye.
The sleeping room is well lit and ventilated. Windows should have movable curtains. /Icyumba abana baryamamo gifite urumuri n’umwuka bihagije kandi amadirishya afite amarido yimukanwa.

sections.title: 9. Playground/Outdoor Play Area/Ikibuga/Aho abana bakinira hanze

items.text: The outside play area is clean and free from hazards. /Hanze aho abana bakinira harasukuye kandi nta byakwangiza abana bihari.
There is at least 2 m2 space per child for outdoor play. (total sqm of the playground/Total number of children) /Harinibura ahantu ho kwisanzurira hangana na m2 kuri buri mwana mu mikino yo hanze

There is safe outdoor play equipment and materials for motor skills and holistic development. /Hanze hari aho gukinira hatekanye kandi hari n’ibikinisho bimwe bifasha abana mu mikurire mu buryo bukomatanyije
Where the facility includes primary/secondary sections, the ECD playground is separate. /Ahari ikigo mbonezamikurire, amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye, ibibuga biratandukanye.
The playground has a variety of surface areas: earth, grass or sand. /Ikibuga k’imikino gifite ahantu hatandukanye hakinirwa imikino itandukanye: itaka, kuba gipavomye cyangwa gitwikiriwe n’umucaca.

Outdoor play area is step-free and well maintained to ensure children with visual or physical impairments move without hindrance. /Aho abana bakinira hanze nta ngazi zihari/esikariye kandi hahora hitabwaho kugira ngo abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona n’abafite ubundi bumuga bw’ingingo bashobore gutambagira nta nkomyi.
A fenced playground is available and play equipment is installed away from a reserved running space. /Ikibuga k’imikino kirazitiye kandi ibikoresho by’imikino ntibibangamira ukwisanzura kw’abana.
Indoor and outdoor play are always supervised by adult (s). /Imikino yo hanze n’iyo mu cyumba k’ishuri buri gihe ikurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru.

sections.title: 10. Play equipment/Ibikinisho byo hanze

items.text: There is child-friendly fixed equipment (climbing frame, swings, merry-go-round, etc.) /Ibikoresho by’imikino byo hanze bijyanye n’ikigero cy’abana nk’imyicungo n’ibyo bagenderaho, inzego burira, ibyo banyuramo bunamye, n’ibindi.
There are movable play materials including ropes, balls, tyres, hoops etc./ Hari ibikinisho byimukanwa bigizwe n’imigozi, imipira, amapine, ibiziga, n’ibindi
There is a sandpit with recycled scoops and containers./ Urugo  mbonezamikurire rufite icyobo kirimo umucanga wo gukiniramo n’ibikoresho bitandukanye byo gukinisha mu mucanga

There is a water play area with recycled containers and other world discovery tools./ Urugo mbonezamikurire gifite aho abana bakinira n’amazi bifashishije ibikoresho bitandukanye bituma bavumbura ibintu byinshi ku mazi.
Play materials are undamaged, with no sharp edges or protruding surfaces. /Ibikinisho bifite ubuso bunyerera, butabyimbye, imigongo idatyaye, ku buryo bitangiza abana mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose.
Areas for jumping, climbing and sliding are covered with soft ground, sand or grass. /Aho abana basimbukira, aho bazamukira ku ngazi, aho bicungira hari itaka ryoroshye, umucanga cyangwa ibyatsi.
There is play equipment accessible by children with disabilities. /Hari ibikinisho by’abana bafite ubumuga.
Locally made play and learning materials and toys are available. /Uretse ibikinisho bigurwa byakorewe mu nganda, hari n’ibikinisho byakozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho urugo mbonezamikurire ruherereye.

sections.title: 11. Health Practices and Procedures/ Ubuzima

items.text: Children’s registration forms (including identification, health status, immunizations, contact information and any parental concerns) are available. /Hari ifishi igaragaza umwirondoro w’umwana, ubuzima bwe, inkingo, terefone z’ababyeyi ndetse n’ibindi bibazo ababyeyi bazi ku mwana.
Immunization cards are verified at the time of registration. /Ifishi y’ikingira igenzurwa mu gihe cyo kwandika umwana.
The facility has a health worker’s contact for health-related issues./ Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite terefone y’umujyanama w’ubuzima yitabazwa mu bibazo bijyanye n’ubuzima bw’abana.
Containers with safe drinking water and clean cups for each child are available. /Urugo rufite ibikoresho byo kubikamo amazi yo kunywa kandi buri mwana akagira igikombe ke cyo kunywesha.
The facility has information about children with medical insurance. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rubika amakuru ku bwishingizi bw’indwara ku bana.

Guidelines with child-friendly pictures on how to manage communicable disease outbreaks or promote good practices such as handwashing are on display. /Amabwiriza ajyanye n’uko abantu birinda indwara zandura, ibyorezo, gukaraba intoki amanitse kandi aherekejwe n’amashusho abisobanura.

Children aged 3–6 are screened for developmental delay/disability by community health workers, or early detection by parents, health professionals. /Abana kuva ku myaka 3- 6 basuzumwa hagamijwe kureba abafite cyangwa bafite ibyago byo kugira ibibazo by’idindira mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga, bigakorwa n’abajyanama b’ubuzima cyangwa ababyeyi n’inzobere mu buzima.
Referral procedures are established for children with suspected developmental disability. /Abana bagaragaje ibibazo by’idindira cyangwa ubumuga bashakirwa ubufasha bujyanye n’ibibazo byagaragajwe.
There are guidelines for children and staff during emergency cases (diseases, outbreak, risks etc.). /Hari amabwiriza asobanura uko abakozi n’abana bakwitwara mu gihe k’ibyago cyangwa Ibiza.

sections.title: 12. Food and Nutrition Practices /Imirire

items.text: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per MIYCN National Counselling package. /Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye nk’uko amabwiriza agenga kugaburira abana ku ishuri abiteganya.
Cooks and food suppliers are trained on food hygiene and safety. /Abatetsi n’abandi bafite aho bahurira n’ibiribwa bahuguwe ku bijyanye n’ibiribwa, isuku yabyo ndetse n’umutekano w’abana.

Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and covering their hair. /Abatetsi n’abandi bafite aho bahurira n’ibiribwa bahorana isuku bakaraba intoki bakanambara ingofero.

During mealtimes, children are always supervised by an adult to ensure that all children are eating, to prevent choking and teach good table manners. /Mu gihe cyo gufata amafunguro, abana bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru kugira ngo arebe ko abana bose barya, arinde abana ko ibiryo byabaniga akanabigisha imyitwarire ikwiye ku meza.
ECD facility has a kitchen garden with fruit and vegetables to be used in a balanced diet. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite akarima k’igikoni karimo imbuto n’imboga bikoreshwa mu gutegura indyo yuzuye.
Children with eating difficulties are identified and parents are informed of any issues. /Abana bafite ibibazo mu mirire, bimenyeshwa ababyeyi babo kugira ngo bifatirwe imyanzuro.

sections.title: 13. Child Protection/Safety Practices/Umutekano no kurinda umwana

items.text: Children are accompanied to and from the ECD facility by an adult. /Umwana aza ku rugo ambonezamikurire kanataha aherekejwe n’umuntu mukuru.

All staff receive regular training on health and safety issues pertaining to the ECD facility. /Abakozi bose bahawe amahugurwa ahoraho ku bijyanye n’ubuzima n’umutekano w’abana bibera mu rugo mbonezamikurire.

ECD facilities have materials to use in case of fire outbreak (fire extinguisher or a sand bucket and water); caregivers are trained how to use them. /Hari ibikoresho byakwifashishwa mu kuzimya inkongi y’umuriro (kizimyamwoto, amazi, umucanga) kandi abakozi bahuguwe uko bikoreshwa.
Covered sockets are used to protect children from electric shock. /Aho bacomekera ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi hakoreshwa ibikoresho byabugenwe bidatuma abana binjizamo ibintu uko biboneye.
First aid kits and any medicines for children are kept out of children’s reach. /Agasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze n’imiti ibamo bibitswe kure aho abana bategera.

All ECD service providers are trained on how to use the contents of the first aid box and how to deal with accidents. /Abatanga serivisi z’imbonezamikurire bose bahuguwe ku bijyanye no gukoresha ibiri mu gasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze.
A lightning conductor is installed on the roof. /Umurindankuba washyizwe ku gisenge kugira ngo inyubako n’abantu barindwe inkuba
A list of emergency contacts readily available to the staff. /Nimero za terefone zihamagarwa mu gihe habaye impanuka ikomeye cyangwa ikindi cyago zimanitse ahantu byoroheye abakozi bose kuzibona.
Children are supervised by an adult when playing outside. /Abana bafite umuntu ubakurikirana igihe bakina hanze. Nibura umurezi umwe ku bana 30.
A sign prohibiting intruders from the ECD facility is placed at the entry point. /Icyapa kibuza abantu bo hanze kwinjira mu kigo kimanitswe ku marembo aho binjirira.
Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children’s reach. /Ibikoresho byateza impanuka bibikwa kure aho abana batagera.

All toys for younger children are non-toxic and oversized so that children cannot swallow or choke on them, or put them in their ears. /Ibikinisho byose bigenewe abana bato bisize irangi ritakwangiza abana baramutse babishyize mu kanwa, nta n’ubwo ari bito cyane ku buryo byateza impanuka.
The compound is fully fenced and has a lockable gate. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite uruzitiro n’amarembo afungwa ku mpamvu z’umutekano w’abana.
An enclosed compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound. /Icyobo k’ingarani (ikimoteri) kimenwamo inyanda kiri kure y’aho abana bakinira kandi kiratwikiriye ku bw’umutekano w’abana.

Where transport is provided, the school bus has adequate, comfortable seats fitted with child-appropriate safety belts. /Urugo girufite imodoka itwara abana, imodoka ifite intebe zikwiranye n’abana, zifunze neza kandi buri ntebe ifite umukandara.

sections.title: 14. WASH/ Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura

items.text: Safe drinking water is always available for drinking and washing hands. /Abarezi n’abana bafite amazi yo kunywa ku buryo buhoraho.
There are enough water storage containers for drinking water and they are regularly cleaned. /Hari ibikoresho bibika amazi yo kunywa kandi bikagirirwa isuku ku buryo buhoraho.

Drinking guidelines are observed (1,000 ml per day for children aged 3; 1,200 ml for children aged 4-5). /Abana bafite imyaka 3 bagenewe mililitiro 1000 z’amazi ku munsi naho abafite guhera ku myaka 4-6 bagenewe mililitiro 1200 z’amazi ku munsi.
There is running water at the premises or a public water point within 500 m. /Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hari isoko y’amazi cyangwa amazi aboneka nibura muri metero 500 uvuye ku kigo.

The entire compound and equipment (including classrooms, toilets, kitchen, and playground) are cleaned every day. /Urugo mbonezamikurire, ibikoresho, ibyumba by’amashuri, imisarani, igikoni n’ikibuga abana bakiniraho bisukurwa buri munsi.
There is a staff member in charge of hygiene and sanitation. /Hari umukozi uhoraho ushinzwe isuku n’isukura.
Children are clean and wear uniform for easy identification. /Abana bahorana isuku kandi bambaye umwambaro w’ishuri ubaranga.

A water container with clean water and soap is available for use in the classroom, toilets, kitchen and other places. /Ibikoresho bibika amazi n’isabune biba bihari kugira ngo byifashishwe mu isuku yo mu mashuri, mu misarani, mu gikoni n’ahandi hantu.
Mobile handwashing stations and/ or a multitap handwashing stand are available and inclusive. /Ibikarabiro cyangwa kandagira ukarabe biri ku burebure bw’abana kandi ntibiheza abana bafite ubumuga.

Adequate enclosed facilities for the disposal of waste are available and regularly emptied. /Ibikoresho byabugenwe byo gushyiramo imyanda birahari, bikavidurwa ku gihe kandi bipfundikirwa ku bw’umutekano w’abana.
Bushes and pools of water around the ECD facility are cleared./ Ibihuru n’ibizenga by’amazi biri mu rugo mbonezamikurire bikurwaho kugira ngo bitaba indiri y’inzoka n’imibu.
Each facility has health education posters teaching children handwashing practices. /Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite icyapa kigisha abana ibijyanye no gukaraba intoki ndetse n’indyo yuzuye.

sections.title: 15. Teaching and learning approaches, methods and strategies/Uburyo bw’imyigishirize mu rugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: Caregivers apply thematic-integrated, holistic and contextualized approaches/ Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bushingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko, uburyo bukomatanyije kandi bushingira ku byo abana basanzwe bazi.
Caregivers apply a play-based learning approach. / Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bushingiye ku mikino.
Caregivers use multi-sensory approach./ Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bushingiye ku byumviro byose: kureba, kumvisha amatwi, gukorakora, kumvisha amazuru, kumvisha ururimi.
Caregivers tell/read stories to children reflecting the themes of the week. / Abarezi babwira/basomera abana inkuru zijyanye n’insanganyamatsiko y’icyumweru.

Caregivers use songs/rhymes/poems to develop different skills connected to themes. / Abarezi bakoresha indirimbo/imivugo kugira ngo bazamure ubushobozi bw’abana ku nsanganyamatsiko zitandukanye bijyanye
The facility is rich in inclusive teaching and learning materials. / Urugo mbonezamikurire rukungahaye ku mfashanyigisho zidaheza abana bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 16. Organisation of teaching and learning activities/play activities/Kuyobora ibikorwa by’imyigire n’imyigishirize.

items.text: The CBC and national parenting curriculum are used / Integanyanyigisho y’amashuri y’inshuke ishingiye ku bushobozi n’integanyanyigisho ku burere buboneye ni zo zikoreshwa.
Children aged 3–5 have access to activities that promote skills in the six learning areas. /Abana kuva ku myaka 3-5 bakora ibikorwa biteza imbere ubushobozi mu byigwa 6 by’integanyanyigisho.

Children are given opportunities to express themselves using all forms of communication (verbal and non-verbal) and are listened to. / Abana bahabwa umwanya wo kwisobanura bakoresheje uburyo bwose (ubukoresha kuvuga, ubudakoresha kuvuga) kandi bagategwa amatwi.
Children have access to a print-rich environment (indoor and outdoor). / Abana bigira mu ishuri rikungahaye ku mfashanyigisho zanditse (mu cyumba k’ishuri no hanze)
Children have access to activities that develop fine motor and pre-writing skills. / Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bibafasha kuzamura ubushobozi bwo gukoresha intoki n’ibibategura kwandika.
The daily schedule runs to at least 4 hours. / Gahunda y’ibikorwa by’umunsi imara nibura amasaha 4.

Children with sensory impairment have access to materials that maximize their capabilities. / Abana bafite ubumuga mu byumviro bitandukanye bafite ibikoresho bibafasha kubona amakuru ashoboka ku mfashanyigisho ku byigwa bitandukanye.

The daily schedule balances and alternates activities: quiet-noisy; indoor-outdoor, active-passive etc. / Gahunda y’umunsi igenda isimburanya ibikorwa: ibikorwa bituje-ibisaba kuvuga, ibikorwa byo mu ishuri, ibikorwa byo hanze, ibikorwa abana bagiramo uruhare.

The classroom encourages children to play with various materials, including locally available items. / Uburyo ishuri riteguye bukurura abana kandi bubashishikariza gukinisha ibikinisho bitandukanye harimo n’ibikozwe mu bikoresho biboneka aho ishuri riherereye.

Children’s original drawings, writing and other work are displayed on the walls at their eye level. / Ibishushanyo by’abana, inyandiko zabo n’ibindi bikorwa byabo bimanikwa ku rukuta rw’ishuri aho biborohera kubirebaho.

Children with communication needs are supported to use different communication method(s). / Abana bafite ibibazo byihariye mu kumvikanisha ibitekerezo byabo bahabwa ubwisanzure n’ubufasha bwo gukoresha uburyo buboroheye.
Assessment tools and materials are adapted to cater for children with special needs and disabilities. / Abana bagaragaye ko bakeneye ubufasha bwihariye mu myigire bakorerwa isuzuma ryihariye.

sections.title: 17. Teaching and learning resources/play materials /Imfashanyigisho n’ibikinisho by’imyigire n’imyigishirize.

items.text: Play materials are adapted to suit all children. / Ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho bijyanishwa n’ikigero cy’abana

Learning and play materials are accessible to all children in all six learning areas of the curriculum./ Hari ibikinisho n’imfashanyigisho kuri buri kigwa: imibare, indimi, ubugeni n’umuco, ibidukikije, imibanire n’abandi  n’imbamutima, ibonezabuzima.
Learning promotes the use of ICT in activities such as lesson preparation, making materials, research etc. / Imyigire mu rugo mbonezamikurire iteza imbere imikoreshereze y’ikoranabuhanga.

There is a variety of Rwandan picture books with culturally and age-appropriate stories. (e.g. 1 score/ 1 title) / Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite ibitabo bitandukanye by’amashusho akoze inkuru zijyanye n’ikigero n’umuco by’abana. (1 kuri buri bwoko)

Pre-writing materials like pencils, chalks, crayons, paper and drawing notebooks are available. / Abana bafite ibikoresho bibategurira kwandika: amakaramu y’umuti, amakaramu y’igiti, ingwa, amakarmu y’amabara, urupapuro n’amakayi yo gushushanyamo. (1 score/1 title)
Learning materials are maintained and stored correctly to ensure their safety after use. / Imfashanyigisho n’ibikinisho byakoreshejwe birasukurwa bikabikwa neza kugira ngo umutekano wabyo witabweho.

The facility has and uses CBC guides, scheme of work, training modules/manuals etc. / Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite kandi rukoresha inyoborabarezi ku nteganyanyigisho, isaranganyamasomo, imfashanyigisho z’amahugurwa.
Manila paper/rice sacks and other locally available materials for display are available. / Urugo rufite impapuro nini, imifuka yo kwandikaho n’izindi mfashanyigisho zo kumanika.

sections.title: 17. Organization of field/study visits/ Gutegura no gukora ingendoshuri

items.text: Children leave the compound to explore themes within their community every week. / Abana basohoka urugo mbonezamikurire rimwe mu cyumweru bakitegereza ibintu bibakikije bijyanye n’insanganyamatsiko biga.

One caregiver or parent supervises a group of 10 children and has a list of those children with parents’ contacts. / Umurezi umwe cyangwa umubyeyi akurikirana itsinda ry’abana 10 kandi akaba afite urutonde rw’abana na nimero za terefone z’ababyeyi.
The lead caregiver carries a first aid kit during the study visit. / Umurezi uyoboye urugendo shuri atwara agasanduku k’ubutabazi bw’ibanze.

sections.title: 18. Establishment, registration and accreditation /Gutangiza, kwandikisha no kwemeza urugo mbonezamikurire

items.text: The ECD facility is registered / Urugo mbonezamikurire ruranditse
The ECD facility is accredited / Urugo mbonezamikurire rwahawe uburenganzira bwo gukora.

sections.title: 19. Collaborative, supportive relationships with families and communities/Imikoranire hagati y’urugo mbonezamikurire n’ababyeyi

items.text: Parents were involved in setting up the facility. / Ushinzwe urugo mbonezamikurire afatanya n’ababyeyi mu gutangiza ibikorwa byo guha abana serivisi mbonezamikurire.
Parents have a general assembly meeting once a term. / Ababyeyi bose cyangwa abarera abana bahura nibura rimwe mu gihembwe.

Parents visit the facility to get feedback on the children’s progress. / Ababyeyi basura abana kugira ngo bahabwe amakuru y’uko abana bahagaze mu byigwa bitandukanye by’integanyanyigisho n’imikurire muri rusange.
The PTC is available. / Hari komite nyobozi y’inama y’ababyeyi.

The ECD provider establishes communication and feedback mechanisms between parents and the facility management. / Ushinzwe urugo mbonezamikurire ashyiraho uburyo ababyeyi n’ubuyobozi bw’urugo bazajya bahanahana amakuru ku buzima bw’abana mu rugo mbonezamikurire ndetse n’iwabo mu ngo.

Collaboration between the ECD facility and local authorities is evidenced by quarterly reports, meetings and supervision. / Hari imikoranire myiza hagati y’urugo mbonezamikurire n’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze bigaragarira muri raporo zitangwa, mu nama n’igenzurabikorwa.

sections.title: 20. Assessment/ Isuzuma

items.text: Assessment is formative and holistic / Isuzuma rikoreshwa mu rugo mbonezamikurire ni iry’imyigire n’imyigishirize aho kuba irisoza inyigisho.

The assessment covers all six learning areas of the curriculum. / Isuzuma rikorwa ku byigwa 6 biri mu nteganyanyigisho y’amashuri y’inshuke ishingiye ku bushobozi bireba imikurire y’umwana n’imyigire bishingiye ku bushobozi bwitezwe ku mwana nyuma ya buri kigwa.
Progress reports are shared and discussed with individual parents and/or in groups. / Amanota y’abana asangizwa ababyeyi bakayaganiraho buri mubyeyi ku giti ke cyangwa itsinda ry’ababyeyi
Children’s progress reports contain detailed developmental and learning information./ Amanota y’abana atanga amakuru arambuye ku mikurire n’imyigire y’umwana.

A colour-coded rating is used to share children’s progress with parents: Green, Blue, Yellow and Red. / Mu rugo mbonezamikurire hakoreshwa amabara mu kugaragariza ababyeyi uko abana bateye imbere mu byigwa bitandukanye by’integanyanyigisho: Icyatsi, Ubururu, Umuhondo, Umutuku

sections.title: 21. ECD Staff recruitment and CPD/Ishyirwamukazi ku barezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire.

items.text: If an ECD facility not attached to a primary school, there is an ECD coordinator. / Gushyira abarezi b’abana mu rugo mbonezamikurire bikurikiza amabwiriza ya Minisiteri y’Uburezi agenga ishyirwa mu kazi ry’abarimu.
There is one caregiver and an assistant in each classroom. / Icyumba abana bigiramo gishyirwamo abarezi babiri
There is at least one cook recruited under a renewable contract. / Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite nibura umutetsi.
There is at least one guard recruited for security purposes / Urugo mbonezamikurire rufite nibura umuzamu.

ECD caregivers and support staff are entitled to salary or fringe benefits/incentives. / Abarezi n’abandi bakozi b’urugo mbonezamikurire bemerewe ibi bikurikira: umushahara n’amashimwe kimwe n’abandi bakozi bari ku rwego rumwe mu mashuri abanza.
CPD activities are organized by the school or via links with neighbouring schools. / Amahugurwa ahoraho ategurwa n’ubuyobozi bw’urugo mbonezamikurire cyangwa rukihuza n’izindi mu kuyategura.
All ECD providers receive initial and ongoing training. / Abashinzwe ingo mbonezamikurire bose bahabwa amahugurwa y’ibanze n’andi mahugurwa ahoraho ku buryo bwo gutanga serivisi mbonezamikurire.

The training content in ECD programme is validated jointly by REB and NCDA. / Kwemeza imfashanyigisho z’amahugurwa ku mbonezamikurire bizajya bikorwa ku bufatanye hagati y’Urwego rw’Igihugu rushinzwe Uburezi bw’Ibanze (REB) n’Ikigo k’Igihugu Gishinzwe Imikurire no Kurengera Umwana (NCDA).
